about: Results measured on current FreeWRL builds. Empty until a test run is recorded. One entry per node per build.

schema.component: component name exactly as in conformance.upstream.json
schema.build: FreeWRL version and platform, e.g. 6.7.0 macos-arm64 beta.2
schema.tests: test files used, paths relative to tests/
schema.evidence: URL of the report, screenshots or log
